info.description: The Selling Partner API for Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA) Inbound. The FBA Inbound API enables building inbound workflows to create, manage, and send shipments into Amazon's fulfillment network. The API has interoperability with the Send-to-Amazon user interface.
info.title: The Selling Partner API for FBA inbound operations.

Address.description: Specific details to identify a place.

countryCode.description: The country code in two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

name.description: The name of the individual who is the primary contact.

AppointmentSlotTime.description: An appointment slot time with start and end.

endTime.description: The end timestamp of the appointment in UTC.

startTime.description: The start timestamp of the appointment in UTC.

Currency.description: The type and amount of currency.

code.description: ISO 4217 standard of a currency code.

Dates.description: Specifies the date that the seller expects their shipment will be shipped.

Error.description: Error object containing information about what went wrong.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

example.details: The shipment is in a status that does not allow it to be edited.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

FreightInformation.description: Freight information describes the SKUs that are in transit. Freight carrier options and quotes will only be returned if the freight information is provided.

InboundPlan.description: Inbound plan containing details of the inbound workflow.

createdAt.description: The time at which the inbound plan was created. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) datetime with pattern `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The time at which the inbound plan was last updated. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) datetime format with pattern `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

items.description: The Marketplace ID. For a list of possible values, refer to [Marketplace IDs](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/marketplace-ids).

name.description: Human-readable name of the inbound plan.

packingOptions.description: Packing options for the inbound plan. This property will be populated when it has been generated via the corresponding operation. If there is a chosen placement option, only packing options for that placement option will be returned. If there are confirmed shipments, only packing options for those shipments will be returned. Query the packing option for more details.

placementOptions.description: Placement options for the inbound plan. This property will be populated when it has been generated via the corresponding operation. If there is a chosen placement option, that will be the only returned option. Query the placement option for more details.

shipments.description: A list of shipment IDs for the inbound plan. This property is populated when it has been generated with the `confirmPlacementOptions` operation. Only shipments from the chosen placement option are returned. Query the shipment for more details.

status.description: Current status of the inbound plan. Possible values: `ACTIVE`, `VOIDED`, `SHIPPED`, `ERRORED`.

createdAt.description: The time at which the inbound plan was created. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) datetime format with pattern `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

lastUpdatedAt.description: The time at which the inbound plan was last updated. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) datetime format with pattern `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

items.description: The Marketplace ID. For a list of possible values, refer to [Marketplace IDs](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/marketplace-ids).

name.description: Human-readable name of the inbound plan.

status.description: The current status of the inbound plan. Possible values: `ACTIVE`, `VOIDED`, `SHIPPED`, `ERRORED`.

Item.description: Information associated with a single SKU in the seller's catalog.

asin.description: The Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) of the item.

expiration.description: The expiration date of the MSKU. In [ISO 8601](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/iso-8601) datetime format with pattern`YYYY-MM-DD`. The same MSKU with different expiration dates cannot go into the same box.

fnsku.description: A unique identifier assigned by Amazon to products stored in and fulfilled from an Amazon fulfillment center.

labelOwner.description: Specifies who will label the items. Options include `AMAZON`, `SELLER`, and `NONE`. `AMAZON` is not an accepted value in the US marketplace.

prepInstructions.description: Special preparations that are required for an item.

quantity.description: The number of the specified MSKU.

items.description: The items in an inbound plan.

inboundPlans.description: A list of inbound plans with minimal information.

LtlTrackingDetail.description: Contains information related to Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) shipment tracking.

billOfLadingNumber.description: The number of the carrier shipment acknowledgement document.

freightBillNumber.description: The number associated with the freight bill.

PackingOptionSummary.description: Summary information about a packing option.

status.description: The status of a packing option. Possible values: 'OFFERED', 'ACCEPTED', 'EXPIRED'.

Pagination.description: Contains tokens to fetch from a certain page.

nextToken.description: When present, pass this string token in the next request to return the next response page.

PlacementOptionSummary.description: Summary information about a placement option.

placementOptionId.description: The identifier of a placement option. A placement option represents the shipment splits and destinations of SKUs.

status.description: The status of a placement option. Possible values: `OFFERED`, `ACCEPTED`.

PrepInstruction.description: Information pertaining to the preparation of inbound goods.

prepOwner.description: In some situations, special preparations are required for items and this field reflects the owner of the preparations. Options include `AMAZON`, `SELLER` or `NONE`. `AMAZON` is not an accepted value in the US marketplace.

prepType.description:
Type of preparation that should be done.

Possible values: `ITEM_LABELING`, `ITEM_BUBBLEWRAP`, `ITEM_POLYBAGGING`, `ITEM_TAPING`, `ITEM_BLACK_SHRINKWRAP`, `ITEM_HANG_GARMENT`, `ITEM_BOXING`, `ITEM_SETCREAT`, `ITEM_RMOVHANG`, `ITEM_SUFFOSTK`, `ITEM_CAP_SEALING`, `ITEM_DEBUNDLE`, `ITEM_SETSTK`, `ITEM_SIOC`, `ITEM_NO_PREP`, `ADULT`, `BABY`, `TEXTILE`, `HANGER`, `FRAGILE`, `LIQUID`, `SHARP`, `SMALL`, `PERFORATED`, `GRANULAR`, `SET`, `FC_PROVIDED`, `UNKNOWN`, `NONE`.

availabilityType.description: The type of delivery window availability. Values: `AVAILABLE`, `BLOCKED`, `CONGESTED`, `DISCOUNTED`

deliveryWindowOptionId.description: Identifier of a delivery window option. A delivery window option represent one option for when a shipment is expected to be delivered.

editableUntil.description: The timestamp at which this Window can no longer be edited.

endDate.description: The end timestamp of the window.

startDate.description: The start timestamp of the window.

SelfShipAppointmentDetails.description: Appointment details for carrier pickup or fulfillment center appointments.

Shipment.description: Contains information pertaining to a shipment in an inbound plan.

amazonReferenceId.description: A unique identifier created by Amazon that identifies this Amazon-partnered, Less Than Truckload/Full Truckload (LTL/FTL) shipment.

placementOptionId.description: The identifier of a placement option. A placement option represents the shipment splits and destinations of SKUs.

selectedTransportationOptionId.description: Identifier of a transportation option. A transportation option represent one option for how to send a shipment.

selfShipAppointmentDetails.description: List of self ship appointment details.

shipmentConfirmationId.description: The confirmed shipment ID which shows up on labels (for example, `FBA1234ABCD`).

shipmentId.description: Identifier of a shipment. A shipment contains the boxes and units being inbounded.

status.description:
The status of a shipment. The state of the shipment will typically start as `UNCONFIRMED`, then transition to `WORKING` after a placement option has been confirmed, and then to `READY_TO_SHIP` once labels are generated.

Possible values: `ABANDONED`, `CANCELLED`, `CHECKED_IN`, `CLOSED`, `DELETED`, `DELIVERED`, `IN_TRANSIT`, `MIXED`, `READY_TO_SHIP`, `RECEIVING`, `SHIPPED`, `UNCONFIRMED`, `WORKING`

ShipmentDestination.description: The Amazon fulfillment center address and warehouse ID.

address.description: The address the shipment should be sent to. This can be empty if the destination type is `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`.

destinationType.description: The type of destination for this shipment. Possible values: `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`, `AMAZON_WAREHOUSE`.

warehouseId.description: The warehouse that the shipment should be sent to. This can be empty if the destination type is `AMAZON_OPTIMIZED`.

ShipmentSource.description: Specifies the 'ship from' address for the shipment.

sourceType.description: The type of source for this shipment. Possible values: `SELLER_FACILITY`.

shipmentId.description: Identifier of a shipment. A shipment contains the boxes and units being inbounded.

status.description:
The status of a shipment. The state of the shipment will typically start as `UNCONFIRMED`, then transition to `WORKING` after a placement option has been confirmed, and then to `READY_TO_SHIP` once labels are generated.

Possible values: `ABANDONED`, `CANCELLED`, `CHECKED_IN`, `CLOSED`, `DELETED`, `DELIVERED`, `IN_TRANSIT`, `MIXED`, `READY_TO_SHIP`, `RECEIVING`, `SHIPPED`, `UNCONFIRMED`, `WORKING`

SpdTrackingDetail.description: Contains information related to Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipment tracking.

spdTrackingItems.description: List of Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) tracking items.

SpdTrackingItem.description: Contains information used to track and identify a Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) item.

boxId.description: The ID provided by Amazon that identifies a given box. This ID is comprised of the external shipment ID (which is generated after transportation has been confirmed) and the index of the box.

trackingId.description: The tracking ID associated with each box in a non-Amazon partnered Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipment.

trackingNumberValidationStatus.description: Indicates whether Amazon has validated the tracking number. Because shipment validation is asynchronous, tracking IDs might not be validated immediately, and the status might change after a few hours. If more than 24 hours have passed and the status is not yet 'VALIDATED' or `NOT_SUPPORTED`, verify the number and update it if necessary. **Possible values:** `VALIDATED`, `NOT_VALIDATED`, `NOT_SUPPORTED` (Amazon is unable to find tracking information for the provided tracking ID).

TrackingDetails.description: Tracking information for Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) and Small Parcel Delivery (SPD) shipments.

Window.description: Contains a start and end DateTime representing a time range.

editableUntil.description: The timestamp at which this Window can no longer be edited.

end.description: The end timestamp of the window.

start.description: The start timestamp of the window.
